desc: Formalize the reduction: alkane subgraph ⇔ connected vertex subset S of a tree with induced degrees in {1,4} (connected subgraph of a tree must include all induced edges), so DP over induced subtrees suffices.

Design rooted DP states: A[u] (open upward, 0 or 3 kept children), A4[u] (open upward + has degree-4 vertex), C4[u] (closed top of alkane, 1 or 4 kept children + has degree-4 vertex); cut children of a kept node contribute 0 (single-component constraint).

Derive child-merge transitions: exactly k ∈ {0,3} (open) or k ∈ {1,4} (closed) kept children; has-4 flag via k==3/k==4 (u itself) or upgrading one kept child to its A4 value; compute with top-5 A list and O(deg·k) upgrade scan.
Handle the degree-4 requirement: answer = max over u of C4[u]; single-edge all-degree-1 case automatically excluded; output -1 if no finite C4.
Implement iterative post-order traversal, adjacency lists, -inf sentinels, and full stdin/stdout Python solution.
Audit the implemented transitions (A, A4, C4, sum_top_excl bounds, top-5 sufficiency) and hand-trace all three samples to confirm 8 / -1 / 11 before finalizing.
